name: Howard Simons
notable_stories: Legal name Byron Daniel — Dradie filled out the birth certificate differently than Raymond had agreed. Beryl's favorite brother.
milestones: Born 25 Dec 1925, Lynden, Whatcom Co, Washington
Military: Howard enlisted in the military service, and only then learned that his legal name was Byron Daniel.
education: Howard Simons was an elementary school student of Amy Kulp and Alice Burk.
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
John Howard Adams, "John Howard Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: Known as Howard; legal name Byron Daniel Simons. Beryl's favorite brother. Previously referenced in prior sources as 'Byron Daniel Howard Simons.'
His nephew John Howard Adams got his middle name from him and was fond of him. [John Howard Adams, A Memoir, text line 682]
